# netcup_server_image_flavours (Data Source)

The image flavours a netcup server can install (SCP REST API). `image.name` names the system and its boot mode, e.g. `Debian 13.7.0 BIOS amd64`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_image_flavours" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `image_flavours` (Attributes List) Image flavours of the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--image_flavours))

<a id="nestedatt--image_flavours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `image_flavours`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) Alias of the flavour.
- `id` (Number) Id of the flavour.
- `image` (Attributes) Image of the flavour. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--image_flavours--image))
- `name` (String) Name of the flavour.
- `text` (String) Description of the flavour.

<a id="nestedatt--image_flavours--image"></a>
### Nested Schema for `image_flavours.image`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Id of the image.
- `name` (String) Name of the image.
